PAYDAR / BETA 0.5.0

Install and test.

New in 0.5

Permissionless payment capture, optional Google sign-in, account details, sign-out and cloud-account deletion. The website adds stronger scroll-driven 3D depth, responsive type and clearer product sections.

New spending insights show monthly totals, seven-day spending and source-app breakdowns. Guard highlights repeated amounts for review. All figures come from saved receipts; no bank balance or automatic mandate cancellation is implied.

What is included

  • QR decoding from the camera and a selected image.
  • UPI-ID format checks, imported local risk records and explicit unknown results.
  • Three-question MuleGuard guidance and local recovery reports.
  • SubWatcher with pasted/shared message parsing, editing, pause and deletion.
  • Unified transaction history from shared or pasted receipts, manual records and PayDar-format CSV.
  • Account profile, sign-out and Firebase cloud-account deletion.

Permission model

This build deliberately does not request SMS, notification or notification-listener access. It cannot read private UPI-app histories or your inbox. Share a receipt, paste text, import CSV or add a transaction manually.

What is not connected

  • No automated authoritative fraud feed.
  • No physical QR sticker-tamper model.
  • No on-device language model or NPU benchmark.
  • No automatic dispute filing, payment reversal or refund guarantee.

Install

Download the debug APK on Android 8.0 or newer. Android may ask you to allow installation from the browser or file manager. Do not enter your UPI PIN, OTP, password or full card details into PayDar.

Download SHA-256 checksum

Validation

The Android build passed 48 automated checks. Physical-device Google sign-in, account deletion, camera and sharing tests remain pending. The current build has no SMS or notification permission prompts.
